Equipment:
 Over Current Relay 11kv for 
 Feeders
 ISM21 
 BBC

This document outlines 
 the testing procedure P1, which must be performed every six months as 
 indicated by M6 in the title block

This procedure details the steps required to 
 completely check the proper operation and calibration of the relay. The document 
 is formatted the way to minimize the possibility of error causing personal 
 injury or damage to equipment.

The first draft 
 initiated by eng Sawsan El-Lethy, tested by eng. Wael Taha, reversed by EDEPC quality control eng. Adel 
 Abdel Kader El-Naggar, accepted by 
 general director eng. Mohamed Goda El Said, certified by eng. Aly Mostafa Al-Lethy 
 EDEPC inspection & quality control head sector.

Personal protective equipment must be used as safety shoes, and safety 
 Helmet.

items:
A work 
 permit must be issued, qualified maintenance staff carry the suitable safety 
 ID category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Personal protective equipment must be used as safety shoes, and safety 
 Helmet.
Line isolation is required.

The voltage 
 transformer must be out of service.
Secondary injection test set.
Voltmeter, clamp ammeter.

Test leads, complete 
 tool set.

Disconnect the circuit 
 breaker for feeder,

Removed the OC relay set 
 for phase ( R ),

Connect test leads 
 between the current terminal ( 1&2 ) on the OC relay set,

Increase the injected 
 current slowly until the red indication on over-current set appears,

Record this value on the 
 test sheet ( adjust it if needed ),
Switch off the test set,

Repeat the above test 
 from step ( 2 ) to ( 6 ) for phase ( S ) and phase ( T ).

Connect the 
 instantaneous trip contact numbers ( 7&8 ) on the relay to timer terminal on 
 the test set, 
 figure 1

Inject the pick-up 
 current value into the relay for phase ( R ),

Record the time (adjust 
 it if needed),

Connect the time delayed 
 contact numbers ( 2&3 ) on the relay to timer terminals on the test set,

Injecting the pick-up 
 current value into the relay for phase ( R ),

Record the value of time 
 on the test sheet ( adjust it if needed ),

The timer will stop once 
 the relay has picked-up,

Repeat the above test from step ( 
 1&4 ) for phases ( S ) & ( T ).

Put the circuit breaker 
 on the test position,

Request the operator to 
 switch on the circuit breaker,

Injecting the pick-up 
 current into the relay,

Check that the circuit 
 breaker tripped.

Disconnect the test 
 leads from the terminal on the OC relay

Put the OC relay set on 
 this place.

If any equipment 
 associated with the relay has been isolated, it should be returned to service 
 by the following restoration: steps:
 - Breaker trip coil.
 - Breaker failure 
 scheme associated with this relay.
 - Disturbance alarm 
 and fault recorder associated with this relay.
